title: Bat Passes After Sunset Offset Through Season
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=batdetector:pass
| search minutes_after_sunset=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(minutes_after_sunset) as avg_minutes_after_sunset by _time month
| sort - _time
description: Tracks time from sunset to first bat pass over time and breaks it out by month.
value: Seasonal offset from sunset is a practical timing cue for when the detectors should already be live.
implementation: Send time from sunset to first bat pass events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of time from sunset to first bat pass by month.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how time from sunset to first bat pass changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
